task.title: Add task sorting and filtering to desktop and web
task.description:
Allow users of the web board to filter tasks by:
 - Task title
 - Priority
 - Labels
 - Project key, shown only when the project has more than one key, with retired keys included since their tasks still exist. The CLI already has `workbook list --key <KEY>`.

Allow users of the web board and CLI to find tasks by searching all text: `workbook list --find <text>` searching titles, descriptions, labels, possibly comments.

The board has no filter chips today; the Deleted switch (`/?deleted=1`, address-driven through `navigate()`) is the precedent for board-scoped, bookmarkable state.

Rescoped 2026-09-26: sorting is deferred, because a column's order is its drag order and a view-only sort would make dragging meaningless while it is on. The desktop half is dropped; the desktop gets a Next view ("Add a Next view across imported projects to the desktop app") instead of a filtered task list. This task is web board and CLI only and needs its own design before it starts.
